# API Contracts Checklist: SPEC-013A1 - GitHub Sync Automation and Poller Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Validate API-contract requirement quality for manual GitHub sync compatibility, lifecycle status visibility, lifecycle control mutations, scoped overlap behavior, and rollback-safe disablement.
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does `GET /api/github/sync` explicitly preserve existing `syncs` and `poller` response fields while adding the lifecycle envelope? [Completeness, Spec FR-025, Plan §API Contracts]
- [x] CHK002 Does the lifecycle status envelope include enablement, disabled reason, backoff, run timestamps, cursor, counters, errors, skipped state, diagnostics, and active-run conflict state? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, Spec FR-029, Contract §GET /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK003 Does `POST /api/github/sync` explicitly preserve the existing manual `trigger` and `trigger-all` request contract? [Completeness, Spec FR-026, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK004 Does the manual `trigger` success response keep the existing `{ ok, pulled, pushed }` shape? [Completeness, Plan §API Contracts, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK005 Is same-scope manual overlap behavior contractually pinned to one stable v1 outcome rather than leaving queued serialization versus rejection ambiguous? [Spec FR-007, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK006 Is `trigger-all` same-scope overlap behavior specified with a stable response shape for one or more conflicted scopes? [Spec FR-026, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK007 Does `PATCH /api/github/sync/control` explicitly own Product Line/workspace-scoped enablement, disablement, bounds updates, and idempotent backoff reset? [Completeness, Spec FR-027, Contract §PATCH /api/github/sync/control]
- [x] CHK008 Does the control endpoint explicitly avoid mutating production feature-flag registry state? [Completeness, Spec FR-028, Contract §Authentication And Scope]

## Notes

- Four API-contract gaps were found and remediated for deterministic manual overlap behavior, `trigger-all` overlap response shape, disable-while-active policy, and lifecycle status scope filtering.

## Remediation Verification

- [x] CHK023 Does the updated spec choose deterministic 409 rejection for same-scope manual overlap instead of leaving queue-or-reject ambiguity? [Verification, Spec FR-007, Spec FR-026]
- [x] CHK024 Does the updated contract define `trigger-all` conflict preflight and a `conflicts` array for conflicted scopes? [Verification, Contract §POST /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK025 Does the updated contract define non-blocking disablement with 200 response, future-tick prevention, active-run visibility, and manual fallback? [Verification, Contract §PATCH /api/github/sync/control]
- [x] CHK026 Does the updated contract and plan define lifecycle status filtering through existing workspace-scope behavior? [Verification, Contract §Authentication And Scope, Plan §API Contracts]
